gops.title: Global Receiver Operations
gops.confirm_global_close_desc: Close ALL positions across EVERY receiver?
gops.confirm_global_close_detail: This immediately sends market close orders for every mirrored position held by all receivers. This operation cannot be undone.
gops.confirm_global_pause_detail: All connected receiver terminals will stop opening new positions from senders until resumed. Existing open positions remain held.

nodes.confirm_close_all_detail: This immediately sends market close commands for all positions held by this receiver. This operation cannot be undone.

cockpit.fast_close_tooltip: Close orders immediately on click without confirmation dialog
cockpit.btn_queued_tooltip: Queued on receiver; broker will execute upon Monday market open
cockpit.confirm_close_desc: Are you sure you want to close order #{ticket} ({symbol} {side} {lots} lots, Profit: {profit}) immediately?
cockpit.remember_fast_close: Remember choice & enable Fast Close mode (no prompt for subsequent closes)
cockpit.managed_mirrors_sub: Active copier mirror positions managed by engine
cockpit.orphan_manual_sub: External or manual orders with non-copier magic
cockpit.gross_account_open_sub: Total open positions currently active on this terminal
cockpit.pipeline_synced_sub: (0 in broker queue · 0 gate delayed · 0 market closed)

notices.mkt_closed_title: [Market Closed · Queued] Order #{ticket} queued for execution!
notices.mkt_closed_desc: Foreign exchange markets are closed for the weekend. The close order has been accepted into the receiver priority queue and will be executed by the broker as soon as the market opens on Monday.
notices.already_queued_title: Order #{ticket} is already in the execution queue
notices.already_queued_desc: This order has already been queued for closing and is waiting for broker matching.
notices.close_failed_old_ea_title: ⚠️ Close Rejected: Receiver EA running older build
notices.close_failed_old_ea_desc: Please switch timeframe on the chart or press F7 in MT4 to reload the latest EA binary!
notices.toast_queued_mkt: Order #{ticket} queued, broker will execute upon market open.
notices.toast_already_queued: Order #{ticket} is already queued for close

cluster.title: Cluster Status
cluster.input_ip_hint: Leave blank and click 'Clear Peer (Standalone)' if running as an isolated single hub.

ssl.title: 🔒 SSL / HTTPS Settings
ssl.mode_auto_desc: Detects public IP, maps IP.sslip.io and provisions genuine Let's Encrypt cert
ssl.mode_custom_desc: Uses a domain name whose DNS A record points to this VPS
ssl.mode_selfsigned_desc: For offline or intranet testing (browser will show untrusted warning)
ssl.mode_import_desc: Paste fullchain.pem and private key text directly
ssl.input_email_hint: For Let's Encrypt expiry and security notices, optional.
ssl.chk_ondemand_80: On-demand port 80 challenge listener (closed during normal operation)
